answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities from claiming paid work. An agent burns a 50 POA copper deposit for one slot and gets an ivory badge for one verified identity. The slot pays only after a random peer checks the work. A fake that fails or duplicates loses its deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, far more than the work pays. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning, so the network stays a haven for real workers.
